description: Create an order for cells and return the USDC payment details (recipient wallet, token, amount_units, Solana reference, pay_by, status URL). This tool does not pay: the caller sends the USDC transfer itself before pay_by. Same validation and limits as the website (minimum cells, at most 16 colours (image orders are not supported here), rate limits, unpaid orders per IP). accepted_terms must be true and means you accept the terms at https://cellionaire.com/terms. Wall coordinates: x 0..999 (left to right), y 0..999 (top to bottom); cell index = y*1000 + x. If you can pay with x402, use prepare_x402_order instead (one request, no transfer to build). If you have no wallet, give status_url to a human.

accepted_terms.description: Must be true: you accept the terms (https://cellionaire.com/terms).

areas.description: One to 20 non-overlapping areas, each a rect + color and/or a list of cells with colours.

cells.description: Individual cells, each with its own colour (instead of or in addition to rect + color): {x, y, color: "#RRGGBB"}, or the HTTP API form [idx, color] with idx = y*1000+x and color = 0xRRGGBB as an integer (e.g. [500100, 2254506] = {x: 100, y: 500, color: "#2266AA"}).

color.description: Colour of every cell in "rect", "#RRGGBB" (required with rect).

rect.description: A rectangle of cells: top-left x, y and width w, height h (cells).

network.description: USDC network you will pay on.

owner.description: Public display name shown on the cells (max 40 characters). Default "anonymous".

name: create_order
title: Create an order (returns USDC payment details)
